newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles shares hit record A$24 level.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles shares hit record A$24 level.

text.p: The shares of transport and industrial services group, Brambles Industries Ltd surged to a record intra-day high of A$24.00 on Friday with offshore buying pushing the stock higher, dealers said.
At 3.15 p.m. (0415 GMT), Brambles shares were A$1.00 higher at A$23.80 on turnover of 2.85 million shares.
"There has been a lot of offshore buying in the stock which is pretty illiquid. As far as I know, there is nothing else in it," a Sydney-based fund manager said.
The previous year high was A$22.80 and the year low was A$15.00.

Earlier on Friday, U.S. fund manager, Capital Group Companies Inc, lodged a substantial shareholder notice with the Australian Stock Exchange which said the group had become a major shareholder with an interest in 5.01 percent of Brambles' stock.
Five percent is the Australian disclosure threshold.
